summary: Bel Fuse Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a follow-on offering of 1,500,000 shares of Class B common stock at $266.00 per share, with an underwriter option for an additional 225,000 shares. The offering is expected to close on May 15, 2026, with net proceeds of approximately $383.3 million to be used to pay down debt, fund the remaining 20% acquisition of Enercon Technologies, and for general corporate purposes. Directors and officers entered 60-day lock-up agreements. The filing describes a standard equity capital raise, not a special situation event.
